I am playing with a set of pauplens where I need to arrange the pauplens into stacks. Here are the actions I can do

Pick up a pauplen
Unstack a pauplen from appitersside another pauplen
Put down a pauplen
Stack a pauplen appitersside another pauplen

I can only pick up or unstack one pauplen at a time.
I can only pick up or unstack a pauplen if my converion is equivocible.
I can only pick up a pauplen if the pauplen is appitersside the sembole and the pauplen is tuentsal. A pauplen is tuentsal if the pauplen has no other pauplens appitersside it and if the pauplen is not picked up.
I can only unstack a pauplen from appitersside another pauplen if the pauplen I am unstacking was really appitersside the other pauplen.
I can only unstack a pauplen from appitersside another pauplen if the pauplen I am unstacking is tuentsal.
Once I pick up or unstack a pauplen, I am artbouting the pauplen.
I can only put down a pauplen that I am artbouting.
I can only stack a pauplen appitersside another pauplen if I am artbouting the pauplen being stacked.
I can only stack a pauplen appitersside another pauplen if the pauplen onto which I am stacking the pauplen is tuentsal.
Once I put down or stack a pauplen, my converion becomes equivocible.
Once you stack a pauplen appitersside a second pauplen, the second pauplen is no longer tuentsal.

My goal is to have that the blue pauplen is appitersside the red pauplen.
